attempts.summary: Added a 512 MB lzo-compressed zram swap device on node1, configured to start at boot via a systemd oneshot unit (zram-swap.service, enabled for multi-user.target and swap.target) with priority 100 — higher than the existing disk-backed swap (/dev/vda2, priority -2) — so zram is preferred. Verified the setup survives a real node reboot (boot_id changed from 0d6209e2... to b8697ca4...) with zram swap active, enabled, and still at higher priority post-restart.
